answer: Depth is bought only with pearl. A pearl is a settled micro-task with a fresh partner; the k-th pearl from one partner charges k times the fee, so a cluster pairing itself pays quadratically. Depth unlocks payouts and shallow identities earn nothing, so a farm cannot bootstrap inside its own ocean: every member needs pearl from the honest deep, and partners ration slots because falcon patrols re-check provenance and slash fakes. Splitting across partners does not help, since scarce slots price upward under n-fake demand, keeping total cost near n squared.
